sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:190653
Court No. - 79
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 25086 of 2024

Applicant :- Sanju
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Nabi Ullah
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.

Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1.
Affidavit of compliance has been filed by learned Aga today in court is taken on record.
2. Heard Sri Nabi Ullah, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri A.K. Sand, learned Government Advocate along with Sri Ramesh Kumar, learned A.G.A. for the State.

3. In pursuance of the order of this Court dated 02.12.2024, Ms. Meenakshi Katyayan,
Superintendent of Police, Bhadohi is present in Court.

She has stated in her affidavit of compliance that a preliminary inquiry has been initiated against the erring officers, who are prima facie found to be negligent in execution of non-bailable warrant as well as process under Section 82 Cr.P.C. against the accused.
4. The S.P., Bhadohi also expressed regret and assured the Court that in future she will personally look into the execution of process of the Court against the accused person.
It is also informed by the SP, Bhadohi that the accused Dharmendra Kumar Bind has been arrested today i.e. 05.12.2024 and he will be produced before the court concerned.

In such circumstances, no further order is required Sanju vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 5 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/42028211/

Personal appearance of S.P., Bhadohi is exempted.
5. Now, this Court proceeds to hear the case on merit.

6. The present application has been filed to direct the Chief Judicial Magistrate-1, Gyanpur, Bhadohi to decide the trial of Case No.603 of 2016, under Section 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act,
pending in the court of Civil Judge (Junior Division)/F.T.C. Mahila Utpidan) Bhadohi within a stipulated period.

entities.text: Civil Judge (Junior Division)/F.T.C. Mahila Utpidan) Bhadohi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
7. Contention of learned counsel for the applicant is that as the accused has already been arrested,
therefore, it would be appropriate to direct the court below to conclude the trial expeditiously.
8. After hearing the submission of counsel for the parties and on a perusal of record, it is clear that proceeding of complaint case has been pending since 2016 and relates to offence against woman.

9. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, the Chief Judicial Magistrate-1, Gyanpur,
Bhadohi is directed to conclude the trial of Case No.603 of 2016, under Section 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, expeditiously preferably within a period of one year from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.

10. It is also directed to the concerned court that for ensuring the presence of accused during trial, it should not hesitate to take coercive measures provided under Cr.P.C.
11.
With the aforesaid direction, the application is disposed of.

Order Date :- 5.12.2024 A.Kr.
